what_is.title: What Is PDF Splitting?
what_is.description: PDF splitting allows you to break down large PDF documents into smaller, more manageable files. Whether you need to extract a single page, separate a book into chapters, or divide a legal contract into individual sections, SafeTools provides the precision you need using 100% local browser processing.

privacy.title: Uncompromising Privacy
items: No files ever touch our servers

organization.title: Stay Organized
organization.description: SafeTools keeps your document workflow efficient. When you split a PDF, we preserve the original document's quality, metadata, and internal structure while giving you perfectly separated smaller files for easy distribution and storage.

how_it_works.title: How It Works
how_it_works.note: Documents are never uploaded — processing is 100% local.

performance.title: High-Speed Processing
performance.subtitle: SafeTools leverages your device's hardware for maximum speed:

security.title: Industrial Strength Security
security.description: We utilize the same secure memory sandboxing technology used by modern browsers to protect your financial and legal documents. By strictly avoiding server-side processing, we eliminate the primary risk vector for document leaks: the internet itself.

items.q: Is it safe to split sensitive PDF files?
items.a: Yes. Since SafeTools processes everything locally in your browser, your sensitive data never leaves your computer. We never see your files.

items.q: Can I split a PDF into individual pages?
items.a: Absolutely. You can choose the 'Extract All Pages' mode to turn a 100-page PDF into 100 separate files instantly.

items.q: Does splitting a PDF reduce its quality?
items.a: No. SafeTools preserves the original fidelity of every page, including high-resolution images, fonts, and layout properties.
